headline: Budget 2026: public-service AI and Indigenous workforce funds
digest: Budget 2026 created a $1B Government Transformation Fund and Digital Transformation Canada, plus $451.8M for an Indigenous Workforce Readiness Fund. The EU is planning an AI-literacy certificate for 15-year-olds from 2027–28. The Montreal AI Ethics Institute released its State of AI Ethics Report Vol. 8 (91 contributors), and the Ada Lovelace Institute responded to UK facial-recognition legislation.
